summary: PREVIEW-ONLY re-verification of the belt-and-braces VariationRow raised-date fix. All 6 probes PASSED: 3 API-seeded variations with the exact production ISO values that failed in prod (2026-09-07, 2026-08-30, 2026-08-15), 2 legacy records inserted DIRECTLY into MongoDB (bypassing backend coercion) with plain-ISO and full-ISO-datetime variationDate, and 1 empty-variationDate record inserted directly into MongoDB (to reach the em-dash branch that the backend otherwise masks). Every card rendered DD/MM/YYYY correctly or the em-dash. Global invariant scan of every [data-testid^=vo-row-raised-] on the loaded page: 6 rows scanned, 0 violations of the YYYY-MM-DD forbidden pattern. Bundle at Preview REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirmed to contain the raisedText memo, ISO regex fallback, formatUKDate, and vo-row-raised- testid marker. Same card render path is used for legacy records — legacy_plain and legacy_isodt were inserted straight into Mongo (never touched the API) and both rendered correctly, proving the formatter is on the shared render path, not the create path.

minor.issue: LOGGED PER USER REQUEST (do not fix in this pass): backend coerces empty variationDate to today's ISO on create. Verified again in this iteration — API-seeded record with variationDate='' ended up as today's date. The em-dash branch is only reachable via legacy/direct-insert records. Card render path is unaffected and correct.

action_items: None for the P1a card-render fix. Belt-and-braces render logic is proven correct against production-value parity, null/empty branch, legacy plain-ISO, and legacy ISO-datetime. Safe to redeploy pending user go-ahead.
critical_code_review_comments: VariationRow raisedText memo (VariationOrders.jsx:299-306) is a clean three-tier defence: formatUKDate → inline /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/ regex fallback → em-dash. Verified robust across all four data shapes exercised in this pass.

Because the mongo-inserted legacy records never hit the create/update API, they conclusively demonstrate that the fix lives on the render path (VariationRow) and is applied uniformly to every dashboard card regardless of record origin.
VariationOrders.jsx is 786 lines — future refactor should extract VariationWizard into its own file to stay under the 700-line convention.
